children: Amylyx Pharmaceuticals entered two non-exclusive agreements to secure long-term commercial supply of avexitide. The company signed a five-year Manufacturing and Supply Agreement with Bachem, beginning in 2028, featuring minimum annual purchases, binding forecasts, and annual price adjustments, with automatic three-year renewals. Amylyx also executed a term sheet with Polypeptide Group that includes a $30 million upfront payment to reserve capacity; the parties plan to finalize a definitive agreement providing minimum annual purchases from 2028, binding forecasts, and fixed volume-based pricing with annual adjustments. The dual-sourcing approach is intended to bolster manufacturing resiliency ahead of potential commercialization.
